feed.title: Petfood Watch
feed.subtitle: Daily AI-assisted intelligence on the pet food industry: market, M&A, regulation and innovation news from trade press, with per-article summaries and a daily briefing.

entry.title: Romanian pet food industry attracts new investments
entry.summary: The Romanian pet food industry is drawing external and domestic investments, with companies like Kormotech revamping their operations. This trend highlights growing interest and potential growth in the sector.

entry.title: Nutrition, health and wellness for more good years
entry.summary: The article discusses the shift from focusing solely on lifespan to emphasizing healthspan for pets and humans. It highlights the importance of nutrition, health, and wellness for longer, healthier lives.

entry.title: Top 10 trends shaping cat supplement product development
entry.summary: The piece outlines the top ten trends influencing cat supplement development. It notes that owners prioritize feline biology, palatability, and cat-specific clinical evidence.

entry.title: BioCraft’s cell-cultured cat treat passes palatability test

entry.title: Gen Z to Boomers: How each generation is reshaping pet spending habits
entry.summary: The article examines how different generations influence pet spending habits. It notes that monthly purchases are most common, with Gen X leading at 38%.

entry.summary: Japanese seafood group Umios is ramping up pet food expansion across Asia by taking a 25.1% stake in Thailand‑based Pataya Food Group, aiming to broaden its processed food business.
